recognize_zh: 骨小樑被挖出一個大吸收腔，左側與下方腔壁排著一整排多核蝕骨細胞，腔內充滿疏鬆纖維網狀基質與少量小圓細胞，右側骨小樑外的骨髓有脂肪與造血細胞；這種「蝕骨細胞鑽入骨小樑、腔內纖維化」的隧道狀吸收是副甲狀腺亢進骨病的表現。
features: Bony trabecula with a large internal resorption cavity opening toward the adjacent marrow (tunnelling resorption)
Multiple multinucleated osteoclasts with eosinophilic cytoplasm lining scalloped Howship's lacunae along the cavity wall
Cavity filled by loose, delicate fibrillary fibrous stroma with scattered small lymphoid/hematopoietic cells and a few fat vacuoles
Adjacent marrow on the right with fat spaces, red cells and hematopoietic elements
Lamellar bone of the trabecula otherwise intact with evenly spaced osteocyte lacunae
describe_en: H&E-stained bone marrow trephine section (photographed through the eyepiece) shows a trabecula excavated by a large resorption cavity lined by numerous multinucleated osteoclasts in scalloped Howship's lacunae. The cavity contains loose fibrous stroma with scattered small cells and extends toward the adjacent marrow space, which shows fat and residual hematopoiesis. The pattern of dissecting resorption with fibrous replacement indicates high bone turnover. In a patient with chronic renal failure and hypocalcemia, findings are consistent with renal osteodystrophy due to secondary hyperparathyroidism (osteitis fibrosa).

ddx.vs: Histology is indistinguishable; serum calcium, phosphate and renal function separate primary from secondary disease.
Paget disease shows giant osteoclasts with dozens of nuclei and a mosaic cement-line pattern with osteoblastic rimming rather than fibrous tunnelling cavities.

ddx.dx: Brown tumor or giant cell lesion
ddx.vs: Brown tumors form expansile masses of osteoclast-like giant cells in hemorrhagic fibrous stroma with hemosiderin, rather than resorption confined within trabeculae.
Osteoclasts in tumor-related osteolysis abut neoplastic cells, whereas this cavity contains only bland fibrous stroma.
